name: notes
description: Desktop (Electron) wrapper around the notes PWA — a window showing the bundled app.
author: Niclas Lindstedt <niclas@agilator.se>

scripts.dist: npm run bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
